bakery.introduction: Slow-fermented, small-batch sourdough made fresh each morning in our neighbourhood bakery.

product.name: Sourdough White
product.description: A mild, open-crumb loaf with a crisp golden crust. Lovely for toast, sandwiches and sharing.

product.name: Sourdough Rye
product.description: Earthy rye flour and a long fermentation make this a gently tangy loaf with a satisfyingly dense crumb.

product.name: Sourdough Spelt
product.description: Nutty, naturally sweet spelt gives this tender loaf a delicate flavour and a beautifully browned crust.

product.name: Sourdough Seeded
product.description: A rustic sourdough loaf finished with a generous mix of toasted seeds for extra crunch.
